name: Logical Switch Control
description: Controls logical operations based on the state of several variables.

fields.name: Logical Mode
fields.description: Determines how the four variable checks are combined.

0.name: AND
0.description: Activates when all four variable checks pass.

1.name: OR
1.description: Activates when at least one variable check passes.

2.name: XOR
2.description: Activates when at least one variable check succeeds and at least one fails.

fields.name: Keep Activated
fields.description: Keeps the actor activated after the logical condition becomes false.

fields.name: Play Secret Sound
fields.description: Plays the secret sound when activated. Requires Keep Activated to be enabled.

fields.name: Player Animation
fields.description: Makes the players perform a short animation when activated. Requires Keep Activated to be enabled.

fields.name: Variable 1 that is checked
fields.description: The fourth local variable that is checked by this actor.

fields.name: Variable 2 that is checked
fields.description: The third local variable that is checked by this actor.

fields.name: Variable 2 that is checked
fields.description: The second local variable that is checked by this actor.

fields.name: Variable 1 that is checked
fields.description: The first local variable that is checked by this actor.

fields.name: Variable that will be set when this actor is triggered
fields.description: The local variable that is set when this actor is triggered.
